publication_status: Verified development preview; no release was published by this evidence-retention step.
findings: The Windows application workflow completed successfully and produced a development ZIP whose downloaded bytes, complete file manifest and CRC were independently verified.

The actual opened WPF window passed 39 checks, including inspector and mixer RangeValue edits, synchronized mute/solo controls, undo/redo, source selection/attachment/export, exact source hashes, ruler timing and anchored track headers.

The staged session helper and the independent shared Release helper each passed 52 interactive checks, including 11 exact waveforms, read-only musical ruler timing, stale request rejection and the authored source journey.
The shared Release gate reported 71 tests, executed 70, skipped 1 opt-in generator test and reported zero failures.
The ruler places bar 2 at 2.5 seconds for the authored 96 BPM example; its two measured label positions differ by 80 DIP at 32 pixels per second.
A measured 358 DIP horizontal scroll left all four track-header coordinates unchanged while the measured event moved by negative 358 DIP.
The seven bundled example files match the committed source bytes. The authored source-audition test fixture and expected output are absent from the downloadable package.
The hosted audio endpoint was unavailable. No audio-device playback or audible output was measured.

observed: Four complete colored track rows and their real waveforms are visible.
The source selector displays authored event text and the selected-event header identifies the retained source event.
The compact toolbar fits, colored labels are readable, and inspector controls are visible.
Track headers remain fixed in the zoomed scroll image while events and ruler positions move.
All three captures use the declared client dimensions without black native-frame padding.
remaining_differences: Toolbar density, the Channel and Inspector division, and mixer scale/layout still differ from the reference.
These views and controls do not establish complete interface or functional equivalence.

package_identity_source: Downloaded ZIP matched to CI and committed source

waveform.oracle: Independent signed PCM16 extrema over exact source intervals

ruler.oracle: Authored constant 96 BPM, 4/4: quarter = 5/8 seconds; bar = 5/2 seconds

boundaries: All 20 retained raw records are byte-exact copies of downloaded CI evidence; no image changes or local redactions were applied.

All 44 downloaded text artifacts passed configured private-value and pattern checks plus credential/private-home checks. The images contain authored project labels and synthetic event identity, with no personal material observed.
The PNGs render the client visual tree of the opened WPF window. They are not desktop screenshots and do not capture the native frame. File dialogs and physical input remain untested.
The development ZIP is unsigned. No audio-device playback, physical output measurement, complete Windows parity, general CPR playback or proprietary reference-runtime equivalence is established.
